messages:
kevin: Heads up — EU-WEST p95 token latency spike ~09:14 UTC. Traced some of it to NIC slowpath fallback on a few hosts. CPU softirq shoots up and qdisc drop counts rise. Multi-tenant slices affected, not a single model. Anyone seen this pattern?

linh: Which AZ / node ids? can you paste the ethtool/dmesg?

kevin: nodes: node-uw2-gpu-12, node-uw2-gpu-19, node-uw2-gpu-23. quick ethtool/dmesg snippet below:```# ethtool -S eth0 | grep -E 'xdp_drop|rx_nohandler' xdp_drop: 8423 rx_nohandler: 0 # dmesg | tail -n 20 [ 2434.123456] mlx5_core 0000:03:00.0 eth0: slowpath fallback triggered, xdp_drop high [ 2434.123789] softirq backlog: 1800```

maria: ugh. if NIC is flaking we should shield the heavy tenants ASAP — move them to a dedicated pool while we debug. We can do short-lived dedicated carveouts (warm pool) to avoid user-facing latency, but cost is non-trivial (~$4.2k/wk for the footprint if they stay there).

arun: before big migrations, try toggling off kernel offloads on the NIC (fixed something similar before). Command: `ethtool -K eth0 rx off tx off gro off gso off`. Also check firmware; rolling back to fw 1.2.1 helped last time (we're on 1.2.3 on these hosts).

kevin: Plan proposal: 1) toggle offloads on node-uw2-gpu-12, run perf/canary for 10m. 2) if p95 improves, roll to 19 & 23. 3) if no improvement or regress, immediate targeted drain of the 3 nodes and temporary tenant carveout to dedicated slices.

ops-bot: Deploy bot: cordon/drain initiated for node-uw2-gpu-23 by kevin. (progress updates in #eng-infra)

linh: I'll pull `tc -s qdisc` and tcpdump for a 2m window to confirm whether it's slowpath XDP drops vs HW-level filters. Also checking softirq/irq balance per CPU.

maria: Who owns the dedicated carveout ticket if we need it? I can approve the capacity but need someone to create the ticket + cost tag. @arun?

arun: I can own the ticket and the cost tag. I'll create a dedicated-carveout-1793334444 ticket, estimate capacity, and ping billing.

kevin: Timeline: start offload toggle in ~5m. If toggles fail we expect a 2–3 hour operational window to warm dedicated pool + update routing (no model redeploys). If we go that route we'll temporarily pin affected tenants to dedicated-s1.

linh: quick log update: additional dmesg shows repeated `mlx5_core: slowpath event xdp_drop=8423` and softirq backlog spikes aligned with p95 spikes. Seems like driver falls back to slowpath under certain RX patterns.

maria: :thumbsup: Good. If toggle succeeds, follow-up actions: full fleet firmware audit, add telemetry for `xdp_drop` and `slowpath_fallback` to gpu-node metrics, and an auto-shield rule to move tenants when NIC slowpath > threshold.

arun: Noted — will include billing impact in ticket and add runbook step to notify PL when we carve out.

kevin: Postmortem TODOs (brief): 1) Fleet NIC firmware matrix and plan for rollback/upgrade 2) Telemetry alert for xdp_drop/softirq 3) Auto-shield rule design 4) Verify kernel offload toggles as mitigation 5) Run controlled repro to file bug with NIC vendor.

ops-bot: Incident updated: 1793334444 — status=investigating, owner=kevin.

maria: OK, team — keep updates short here. If we go to carveout, notify #product about possible rate-limit/backfill.

kevin: Toggling now on node-uw2-gpu-12. Will report back in 10m with perf numbers.
